name: im-stuck
description: Break the task out of a loop, confusion state, or false progress and find the fastest safe path forward, routing to a recovery command and editor mode. Use when progress loops or stalls, questions repeat, the wrong command or mode may be in use, or the user is unsure if it is technical, workflow, or scope. Do not use when the next step is clear, for normal routing (use what-next), or for a brand-new task (use task-init). For a vague prompt, use prompt-shape.
